title: Harness log entry contract
description: One append-only log entry for one completed harness function invocation. The persisted log entry integrates the function report with its wall-clock write time; the report contains its session context and function-specific payload.

timestamp.description: Wall-clock time the log entry was appended.

report.description: The function report persisted by this entry.
